columns.render_and_score: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants --scorer-id slurp-slu-official-train --analysis-root <data root>/runs/<run>/<attempt>/supply-variants (one complete official scoring per column, serial, never sharded)

decision_rule_fixed_here: SAME-FLIGHT COLUMN READ (owner decision 172; claim ceiling 'nominated', Q6 ruling). Every column -- a-base (the delivering arm's first-visit column), b-exk30 and t-twin -- is rendered from the sealed first Solver visit through the delivered row's normaliser and projection (the render refuses on any acceptance-test AT1 failure) and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch.score_complete_derived_copy; each contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260928). (1) THE TWIN NULL: t-twin minus a-base on official pooled SLU-F1 (primary) and intent accuracy (guard); the bar on each metric is |twin offset| + the twin's CI95 half-width (the same law as the cross-flight in-chain A/A), reported beside the provisional floor 0.3163 pp SLU / 0.0000 pp intent (scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py, design same-flight-supply-variant: 0.735 x sqrt(200 / 1080)). (2) THE KNOB: b-exk30 minus a-base. NOMINATED iff the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin bar AND the intent CI95 lower bound is not below minus the twin's intent bar. SOLVER-LOCAL HARM iff the SLU-F1 (or intent) CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point delta's magnitude exceeds that metric's twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED (within the twin null). A nomination claims nothing at system level: it only sends the exk30 construction to a full-system read against an in-chain A/A. The utterance-level number is reported beside the row-level one and never gates (Q4). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings.
development_numbers_only: Every number is a TRAIN Fold A development number (owner decisions 28 and 86), never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. The budget is run-cumulative across attempts.
one_factor: arm b-exk30: knowledge_stores.train-exemplars.phase_supply.solver.{k, fuse_coverage.m, fuse_coverage.c, fuse_coverage.top_l} 20 -> 30, at the first Solver visit only; the program switch to phase-native-candidates-review-revise-variants3first-v1 is the instrument's carrier, not a factor, shared by every arm (arm A's request bytes are the AGREE arm's modulo the program id in quoted contact ids and remaining_model_contacts; arm_a_proof)
prohibitions: No test-split, Fold B or DEV contact or read.
No re-flying of the sealed AGREE arm.
No second factor: no other template, knob, store, roster, geometry or session change.
No flight before root mints the decision receipt and the cells are flipped.
No column score opened before the READ row is root countersigned.
No system-level claim: a column effect may only nominate (Q6 ruling).
the_question: At the first Solver visit of every TRAIN Fold A row, does re-capping the train-exemplar Solver supply from k 20 to k 30 (the VAR-1 exk30 construction) move the Solver-local official pooled SLU-F1 of that column beyond the in-flight twin's null, read against the delivering arm's own column in the same flight?
